api.decodeReconciliationOwnerRecord: (bytes: Uint8Array) => ReconciliationOwnerRecord; bounded independent byte copy through typed-array intrinsics, fatal UTF8 decode, parse, validate and require exact canonical signed JCS+LF byte equality. No permissive whitespace/duplicate key/numeric alias/escaped alias accepted. This is canonical ingress, not MAC verification.

canonicalization.implementation: Reuse @devai-nyx/utils canonicalJson only AFTER descriptor-safe bounded copies, safe integer-only numbers and Unicode scalar string validation. That existing utility recursively sorts UTF16 keys, preserves array order and uses JSON.stringify scalars. Do not widen or replace shared utility behavior.
canonicalization.domain: Exact candidate kind/domain pairs, seven literals devai.reconciliation.owner.v1/<kind>
canonicalization.mac_input: UTF8(domain) + single NUL byte + UTF8(canonicalJson(record excluding ONLY top-level mac))
canonicalization.mac: 64 lowercase hex; verify decoded32-byte equality using timingSafeEqual after exact schema validation
canonicalization.key: Exactly32 decoded bytes;44-character standard padded base64, re-encoding byte-identical. Canonical decoder is internal, never exports decoded key. No aliases, whitespace or alternate alphabet.
canonicalization.raw_digest: SHA256 over complete canonical signed UTF8 file bytes INCLUDING trailing LF. Payload digests in formulas below explicitly exclude top-level mac when stated. Do not substitute raw and canonical payload digests.

acyclic_issuer_digest_graph.seed_plan_sha256: Exact already-confirmed first-stage seed/directory plan bytes; excludes future key/issuer/second READY plan
acyclic_issuer_digest_graph.provision_context_sha256: SHA256(canonicalJson({seed_plan_sha256, host_identity_sha256, admission_anchor_sha256:SHA256(canonicalJson(admission_anchor)), installation_bindings_sha256:SHA256(canonicalJson(installation_bindings)), installed_at_head})). This is computed before key/issuer bytes and excludes them.
acyclic_issuer_digest_graph.issuer: Includes seed_plan_sha256 and provision_context_sha256, exact real anchor and immutable installation observations, canonical key/key digest and clock; MAC authenticates that complete unsigned issuer.
acyclic_issuer_digest_graph.second_ready: Final second-stage review plan may bind complete issuer raw bytes/hash and provision_context_sha256. It is NOT included in that issuer. No provision_plan_sha256 field or digest cycle exists.

computable_semantics: Every clock passes existing validateReconciliationClockObservation: positive canonical uint64 ns, safe wall and exact boot/source. This does not sample clocks or check live expiry.

Issuer key_sha256 equals SHA256(decoded raw32 key bytes); provision_context_sha256 matches the exact acyclic formula. Anchor mode/seed/hash/closed identities are shape constraints; physical root canonicality/ownership/inodes remain actual-host responsibilities.

Approval scope repository_id/worktree_id match root fields. scope_sha256 equals SHA256(canonicalJson(scope)); allowed_phases is exactly01,02,03,04. Scope binds exact complete reviewed plan/source bytes, host and current binding digest. Validating the referenced plan/source/host is a separate required actual-host gate.

Approval and renewal validity_ms is1..900000. expires_wall_ms equals clock.wall_ms+validity_ms exactly within safe integer range. expires_monotonic_ns equals BigInt(clock.monotonic_ns)+BigInt(validity_ms)*1000000n exactly within uint64, without Number coercion. These records cannot extend beyond their signed declared deadlines even though the pure clock helper also enforces full maximum windows.

Renewal remaining_phases must be strictly increasing canonical01..04 with no duplicates; resumable_intent_sha256 is explicit null or exact digest. Original scope/remaining phase eligibility/terminal revocation are verified against actual immutable chain by final host, never inferred by this isolated codec.

Phase/action/initiator and predecessor-null rules follow candidate schema:01/02 materialize inspector,03 stage-proof inspector,04 bootstrap-inventory architect; predecessor completion null only01. Completed durability literal is durable but schema alone cannot prove fsync/readback.

Lease signed PID/host/boot/nonce is eligibility input only. Exact original intent and current grant references require actual host verification. Live/reused/EPERM/foreign lease refusal and ESRCH-only exact removal remain native-admission host responsibilities.

input_limits.copy_rules: Plain/null object prototypes only; ordinary/null array prototypes only with exact dense own enumerable data indices plus intrinsic length. No symbols, accessors, extra/nonenumerable keys, holes, Proxy, cycles, undefined/functions/BigInt/nonfinite/unsafe/fractional/negative-zero numbers or lone surrogate strings. Copy to new null-prototype objects/ordinary arrays, deep freeze after schema validation. Charge cumulative serialized byte budget before building full canonical output.
input_limits.byte_rules: Actual non-Proxy Uint8Array/Buffer views only. Use captured typed-array intrinsic getters/copy to bypass caller overrides; refuse shared or detached buffers. Fatal UTF8; exact canonical byte equality rejects duplicates BEFORE provenance is accepted, even though JSON.parse is used internally. No result-defined getters, species, iterator, toJSON/valueOf/toString calls.
input_limits.diagnostics: All native/schema/parser/canonicalization errors become closed safe codes with no raw message/cause/payload/key. Resource bounds use LIMIT_EXCEEDED; invalid UTF8/byte format/noncanonical file uses ENCODING_INVALID; invalid data/key/semantic checks use INVALID; verified shape with wrong MAC uses MAC_INVALID.
